{{Quote|I gotta thank whoever designed this ''Katarn''-class armor for us. It's great stuff. But obviously they never thought we'd need to sit down. Ouch.|[[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>}}
'''''Katarn''-class commando armor''' was armor used by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was named after the [[Katarn/Legends|predatory animal]] from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It weighed 20 kilograms and could cost up to 100,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].

This armor was more expensive and provided better protection than standard clone armor, due to the special composition and novel chemical properties of its armor plates, along with the inclusion of [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. It was also designed for easy [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] injection via handheld dispensers. Katarn armor was often highly customized by the clone commandos who wore it.

==History==
{{Quote|I used to think I wore this armor. Now I think it's wearing me.|[[Darman Skirata|Darman]]|<ref name="Republic Commando: Hard Contact">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Fixer-SWCT.png|thumb|left|250px|Fixer in his Katarn-class commando armor, which featured green markings]]
[[Mark II Katarn-class commando armor|Mark II ''Katarn'' armor]], issued circa four months after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], was reinforced against [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Verpine shatter gun|shatter guns]] and [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|EMP]] weaponry, following recommendations made by [[Omega Squad]] after [[Mission to Qiilura|their tour]] on [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]].

[[Mark III Katarn-class commando armor|Mark III ''Katarn'' armor]], issued circa ten months after the Battle of Geonosis, featured further enhancements, being [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] resistant against ordnance up to laser cannon rounds and light grenades. Night Ops armor first became available at this time.

Several variations of this armor existed for different mission profiles. The ADSD ''Katarn'' armor was designed for deep-space and aquatic infiltration, featuring a fully-pressurized suit with a greater oxygen supply. [[Night Ops Armor]] featured a special stealth alloy that shielded the armor against sensors and made the wearer almost invisible to the naked eye.

Later, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], another version of [[Katarn armor]] was produced, although this resembled [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] and the name "Katarn" was probably just invoked as a reference to the vastly superior Clone Wars variant.

==Specifications==
While there were several variations of this armor, certain features remained constant.

'''Helmet''' - The helmet of the ''Katarn''-class armor had a [[Heads-up display/Legends|HUD]] or heads up display that consistently displayed tactical data such as the location and distance to the target, the health of the wearer and the strength of the suit's shielding. The helmet could system link to others through the use of an internal communications antennae allowing each member of a squad to keep track of their comrade's health and location. Specialized internal sensors could detect the make, model, and relative accuracy of every weapon that a commando used, and could adjust the format of the targeting reticule for differing weapons. The Helmet had a built-in filtration system which could extract oxygen from toxic environments. The visor was designed to incorporate electrobinocular and night-vision modes. It also controlled the environmental features of the suit and had a tactical spot lamp.

'''Body''' - The body of the armor boasted reinforced [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]] plating for defense against blaster fire and other anti-infantry weapons. Its design included resistance to extreme heat and cold. The suit could be fully sealed, allowing a commando to survive in vacuum for up to 20 minutes. The knuckle plate of the armor featured a retractable [[Gauntlet vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] used for close quarter combat and covert encounters. It also contained multiple sensors, including touch induced sensors and environmental sensors as well. Additionally, it had a chronometer featured on the forearm plate.

'''Backpack''' - The backpack featured specialized ammunition cartridges that held various types of ammo, and was modified for many different missions, such as an extra oxygen tank for aquatic and space-borne environments, a large bacta dispenser for augmented healing, or even an external communications array for long distance communications (i.e. subspace transmissions). The backpack usually carried: Explosives, ammo, medical gear, stealth gear, and either rations or gadgets used to survive in different operations. The backpack had a display on it that showed the last two digits of the individual commando's ID number.
